questions.q: In 'The Porcupine and the Snakes', why did the Snakes ask the Porcupine to leave?
choices: His sharp quills pricked them
He ate all of their food
He was too noisy at night
He was rude to them
questions.evidence: His sharp quills pricked them at every turn

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Porcupine and the Snakes'?
choices: Give a finger and lose a hand
Always share your home with others
Snakes are never kind to guests
A cave is the best home of all
questions.evidence: Give a finger and lose a hand.

questions.q: In 'The Fox and the Monkey', why did the Animals make the Monkey their king?
choices: He danced so well with funny capers
He was the strongest of all the beasts
He was the wisest animal in the woods
The Fox told all the Animals to vote for him
questions.evidence: the Monkey was asked to dance

questions.q: In 'The Fox and the Monkey', how did the Fox show the Monkey was not a good king?
choices: He tricked him into a trap with meat in it
He beat him easily in a race through the woods
He told the Animals a secret about the Monkey
He stole his crown while the Monkey slept
questions.evidence: One day he found a trap with a bit of meat in it.

questions.q: In 'The Mother and the Wolf', why did the Wolf wait under the window all day?
choices: He thought the Mother would really give him the child
He was hiding from the farmer's Dogs in the bushes
He was too tired from hunting all night to move
He wanted to hear the Mother sing her lullaby again
questions.evidence: expecting every moment to have the child handed out to him

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Mother and the Wolf'?
choices: Do not believe everything you hear
Always be very quiet in the evening
Mothers sing the best songs of all
Wolves are much too clever to trick
questions.evidence: Do not believe everything you hear.

questions.q: In 'The Flies and the Honey', what happened to the Flies?
choices: They got stuck in the honey and died
They flew away full and very happy
They carried the honey back to their nest
They were swatted away by the housekeeper

questions.q: In 'The Eagle and the Kite', what did the Kite bring back after the wedding?
choices: A tiny Mouse
A big Ostrich
A large fish
A fat Hare
questions.evidence: all he had when he returned, was a tiny Mouse
